title: Saisies D218B geographic route (estimated source geography)

source.candidate_note: Analysis only: shortest D218B chain, small endpoint gaps temporarily bridged; verify bridge geometry before production. Start origin is estimated from video restaurant view, not camera GPS.
source.inputs_note: analysis-cache inputs are provenance only; runtime route points and DEM assets are embedded/project-relative.

dem.sampling: bilinear Web-Mercator pixel mapping; no latitude/longitude degree-as-metre shortcut

height_source: AWS Terrain Tiles / cached Terrarium DEM
old_time_mapping: legacy checkpoints and sections scaled by geographic_length / legacy_length; estimated until landmarks are matched
